items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played saxophone. Norman Mason played saxophone.

ctx.x: Norman Mason, we mentioned, as being around St. Louis, I think he played with two or three of the different bands. He played saxophone, ball, ball, ball, ball.
He played saxophone. Norman Mason played saxophone.
He did play cornet at one time.
